summary: Mailcow is a complete email server suite built on top of standard open-source components like Dovecot and Postfix. It wraps these traditional mail transfer and delivery agents into a containerised architecture with a browser-based administration interface for managing domains and mailboxes.
goodFor: Self-hosters who need to run a full-featured mail server and prefer a unified web interface over manual configuration file editing.
watchOut: Running your own mail server involves significant operational burden regarding IP reputation, spam filtering, and DNS record management. Misconfiguration can easily lead to delivery failures.
deployNotes: Because it is distributed as a set of Docker containers, you will typically need persistent volumes for your mail storage and configuration data, alongside a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination.
